title: runbook-py plan
description: A plan of shell commands executed in order by runbook-py; each command's rc, stdout, stderr and duration end up in a JSON report.

name.description: Plan name, used in the result file name.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed (its process group). 0 or null = no limit. Default: [runbook] timeout from .runbook.ini, else 60.

stop_on_error.description: Stop the plan (remaining commands are skipped) if this command fails, times out or cannot start.

shell.description: true: 'cmd' is a string run with bash -c (or sh -c). false: 'cmd' is an argv list, no shell.

env.description: Extra environment variables, merged with defaults.env. {{variables}} allowed in values.

dangerous.description: The command changes the system: with --confirm dangerous (the default) the operator is asked first.

retries.description: Extra attempts after a failure or a timeout.

stream.description: Force live output on (true) or off (false) for this command.

vars.description: Variables used as {{name}}. Overridden by [vars] in .runbook.ini, then by --var NAME=VALUE. Built-ins: host, fqdn, user, date, time, timestamp, plan_name, runner_host (with a remote target, host and fqdn name the remote host).

redact.description: Regexes masked as [REDACTED] in the report (stdout, stderr, commands, variables).

os.description: Accepted /etc/os-release ID or ID_LIKE values, e.g. ["debian", "rhel"].

commands.description: Binaries that must be in PATH.

requires.description: Checked before anything runs; on failure nothing is executed (exit code 3).

host.description: Target host name or address. {{variables}} allowed.

identity_file.description: Private key; ~ is expanded on the machine running runbook.

ssh_options.description: Extra ssh -o options such as "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes"; they take precedence over runbook's own.

shell.description: POSIX shell that runs the commands on the target, whatever the user's login shell is.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds allowed to open the SSH connection.

remote.description: Run every command on this host through ssh (python is not needed there). Overridden by --remote, --port, --identity, --ssh-option; ignored with --local.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is killed (its process group). 0 or null = no limit. Default: [runbook] timeout from .runbook.ini, else 60.

stop_on_error.description: Stop the plan (remaining commands are skipped) if this command fails, times out or cannot start.

shell.description: true: 'cmd' is a string run with bash -c (or sh -c). false: 'cmd' is an argv list, no shell.

env.description: Extra environment variables, merged with defaults.env. {{variables}} allowed in values.

dangerous.description: The command changes the system: with --confirm dangerous (the default) the operator is asked first.

retries.description: Extra attempts after a failure or a timeout.

stream.description: Force live output on (true) or off (false) for this command.

id.description: Unique id, used by only_if, --from, --only, --skip and the report. Default: cmdN.

cmd.description: Shell string (shell=true) or argv list (shell=false). {{variables}} allowed.

description.description: Why the command is there; shown at confirmation and in the report.

only_if.description: Run only if these EARLIER commands ended ok; otherwise skipped.

skip_if.description: Shell test run first: exit code 0 means the work is already done, so the command is skipped (idempotence).

capture.description: Store this command's stdout (trailing newlines removed) as {{name}} for later commands, also exported to their environment as $name.

stdin.description: Text written to the command's standard input (otherwise stdin is /dev/null).
